channel.title: Morning Brief · Salud y seguridad de la familia
channel.description: Retiros de productos, alertas de salud, seguridad alimentaria y desastres

item.title: A preliminary magnitude 6.9 earthquake hits off the coast of Vanuatu
item.description: USGS recorded a magnitude 6.5 earthquake, Bonin Islands, Japan region. A tsunami warning was associated with this event. [Confirmado] Fuentes: USGS (earthquakes), Associated Press, Reuters

item.title: Agrish Reannounces and Expands Recall of Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; Additional Units Added
item.description: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because when the bed rails are attached to a bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress,… [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

item.title: Giant Bicycle Recalls LED-Light Keys Included with SureLock Bike Lock Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violates Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries
item.description: The LED-light key that was included with certain SureLock Bicycle Lock sets violates the mandatory safety standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because the button batteries can be accessed easily by children,… [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

item.title: HatsanUSA Recalls Blitz Air Rifles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Projectile Hazard
item.description: The recalled air rifles can fire unexpectedly when releasing the bolt before the air rifle is fully cocked, posing a risk of serious injury or death from projectile hazard. [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

item.title: INMO International Technology Limited Recalls INMO Air3 Smart Glasses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard
item.description: The left temple of the recalled smart glasses can overheat during extended use, posing a risk of serious injury or death due to burn hazard. [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

item.title: Amgen drug combined with immunotherapy extends survival in lung cancer trial
item.description: A drug from Amgen could give patients with an aggressive form of lung cancer significantly more time to live when added to an immunotherapy from AstraZeneca. [Probable] Fuentes: Reuters, Financial Times, Bloomberg
